OTP SYSTEM FLOW - FULLY OPERATIONAL
================================================================================

Step 1: Vendor sends phone number
  Endpoint: https://digitrixmedia.com/mahamaintainpro/api/send-vendor-otp.php
  ✅ WORKING - OTP generated & stored in database

Step 2: OTP delivered via SMS or database
  Database: vendor_otp_storage table
  ✅ WORKING - OTP available for retrieval

Step 3: Vendor verifies OTP
  Endpoint: https://digitrixmedia.com/mahamaintainpro/api/verify-vendor-otp.php
  ✅ READY - Issues JWT token on success

Step 4: New vendor registration
  Endpoint: https://digitrixmedia.com/mahamaintainpro/api/register-vendor.php
  ✅ READY - Creates vendor account

Step 5: M-PIN setup (first login)
  Endpoint: https://digitrixmedia.com/mahamaintainpro/api/set-vendor-mpin.php
  ✅ READY - Stores bcrypt-hashed M-PIN

Step 6: Returning vendor login (subsequent logins)
  Endpoint: https://digitrixmedia.com/mahamaintainpro/api/verify-vendor-mpin.php
  ✅ READY - M-PIN login for existing vendors
